contentText: Five Israeli strikes and a shooting overnight and on Thursday killed 10 Palestinians across Gaza, according to officials at Shifa and Al-Aqsa Martyrs hospitals, where the casualties were taken. A strike on a residential apartment in Deir Al-Balah in central Gaza killed a man and his wife, the officials said. FRANCE 24's Jennie Shin speaks with journalist Ahmed Dremly, who was in Gaza until six months ago and has extensively covered the humanitarian crisis there.
